scholarships.title: Schulich Leader Scholarships
scholarships.official_source: Schulich Leader Scholarships (funded by the Schulich Foundation, administered by UJA Federation of Greater Toronto)

existing.description: Schulich Leader Scholarships are Canada's largest undergraduate STEM scholarship programme, launched in 2012 from a CAD 200 million fund. One hundred awards are made each year across 20 partner universities, half worth CAD 120,000 for engineering and half worth CAD 100,000 for science, technology and math, and the funds are disbursed directly by the university over the degree. Every high school or cegep in Canada may nominate one graduating student per year, who then submits a separate scholarship application with two referees.
eligibility: Graduating high school or cegep in Canada in the 2026/2027 academic year
Plan to enroll in an eligible STEM program at one of the 20 partner universities
Strong consideration will be given to students with financial need
Intend to pursue a career in technology, engineering, entrepreneurship and business enterprise, or applied scientific research
existing.eligibility_summary: Graduating Canadian high school or cegep student in the 2026/2027 academic year, a Canadian citizen, planning to enrol in an eligible STEM programme at one of the 20 partner universities, with an entrepreneurial mindset and a stated intention to work in technology, engineering, entrepreneurship/business enterprise or applied scientific research.
benefits: CAD 120,000 (engineering) or CAD 100,000 (science, technology, math) award
All financial needs covered over the course of the Bachelor degree
Entry into an elite national network of Schulich Leaders
Student enrichment opportunities throughout the year
coverage: Full tuition for the eligible STEM degree at the partner university
Living costs and day-to-day financial needs for the whole degree
Student enrichment opportunities and membership of a national Schulich Leaders network
requirements: Applications are submitted electronically; the nomination form link is released only on request from the high school or cegep
Essay highlighting what the nominee is passionate about - 250 words maximum
Essay highlighting an entrepreneurial mindset (leadership, charisma and creativity) - 250 words maximum
Essay highlighting a meaningful risk taken and its outcome - 250 words maximum
Top three achievements (academic or other) - 50 words maximum per achievement
Short answer on career aspirations 10 years from now - 50 words maximum
Universities the nominee wishes to attend must be listed, and a university admission application must be completed by March 1 of the academic year
documents: Up-to-date transcript, credit counsel summary or detailed academic report
Contact information for two referees who upload reference letters
Reference letters of no more than one page, addressed to The Schulich Leader Scholarships Selection Committee
application_method: The high school or cegep publicises the opportunity and selects one Nominee (cegeps may select up to four)
The Nominee receives an application link by email once the nomination is verified
The Nominee submits the online scholarship application with two referees before the application deadline
Referees upload reference letters through the emailed online reference request form
Each partner university selects its own Schulich Leader using its own rubric and adjudication committee
existing.selection_notes: Each partner university selects its recipients independently using its own rubric and adjudication committee; the programme does not set restrictions on receiving other awards.
existing.best_fit: Canadian high school graduates entering an eligible STEM programme at a partner university who have shown leadership, entrepreneurship and financial need.
existing.notes: Pool applications are not accepted: a student must first be selected as their school's Schulich Leader Nominee. Scholarship funds are non-transferable between universities.
existing.application_period: Nominations accepted from September 2026; registration for the 2027 cycle opened in September 2026.
existing.deadline_display: January 27, 2027 - Deadline for school to submit a Nominee; February 17, 2027 - Deadline for Nominee to submit Schulich Leader scholarship application; June 15, 2027 - Scholarship winners finalized.

existing.description: The University of Manitoba awards one International Excellence Entrance Scholarship valued at $25,000 and two valued at $10,000 each to international high school graduates entering University 1 or any faculty, college or school with a direct entry option. The $25,000 award requires a minimum admission average of 90% across five senior level high school courses, while the two $10,000 awards require only the minimum admission requirements for the programme. Short-listed applicants are ranked first, second and third place using the award application and the admissions application. This is a separate application from the admissions application, although both must be completed.
eligibility: Are enrolled full-time (minimum 80% course load) in the first year of study in University 1 or any faculty, college or school at the University of Manitoba with a direct entry option

For the $25,000 award: have achieved a minimum admission average of 90% across five of the following senior level high school courses: Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Sciences, English, First Language Literature, Geography, History, Music and Visual Arts
For the $10,000 awards: have achieved the minimum admission requirements for University 1 or any faculty, college or school with a direct entry option
Have demonstrated strong leadership qualities and sustained, meaningful community involvement
Have completed a University of Manitoba application for admission by December 1, including payment of the application fee
existing.eligibility_summary: International high school graduates applying to University 1 or any faculty, college or school at the University of Manitoba with a direct entry option, enrolled full-time in the first year of study (minimum 80% course load). The $25,000 first-place award requires a 90% minimum admission average across five senior level courses plus demonstrated leadership; the two $10,000 awards require the minimum admission requirements for the programme plus demonstrated leadership.
benefits: Separate funding recognition from the general entrance award pool, which runs on a different deadline
coverage: Cash award of $25,000 for first place
Cash award of $10,000 each for second and third place
requirements: Submit a separate award application in addition to the admission application
Nominate one recommender who is a current teacher or principal
Ensure the recommender submits their letter by the December 1 deadline
documents: One letter of recommendation from a current teacher or principal, translated into English if required
Completed University of Manitoba admission application with the application fee paid
The documentation package the official page collectively refers to as 'all required documentation'
application_method: Apply for admission to the University of Manitoba and pay the application fee by December 1
Submit the award application through the University of Manitoba application portal
Request one recommendation from a current teacher or principal, who must submit it by December 1
existing.selection_notes: Short-listed applicants are ranked in first, second and third place based on the results from the award application and the admissions application.
existing.best_fit: International high school graduates with an exceptional academic average who can document sustained leadership and community involvement.
existing.notes: The official page states the deadline as 'December 1' without printing a year; it is presented under the 2027/28 cycle that the page says is now open, so the December 1 deadline is 2026-12-01. The University of Manitoba's other entrance awards run through a separate General Entrance Award application with a different deadline, so this award should not be assumed to be included in those.
existing.duration: Entrance award for the first year of study
existing.application_period: Application for the 2027/28 International Excellence Entrance Scholarship is open now; the complete application and all required documentation must be received by December 1.
